messages:
Anna (Support): incoming from AcmeCorp — they say SCIM deprovision events aren't in audit logs and some users kept access. also seeing KMS decrypt errors in recent requests. escalation to sec/compliance. ticket #INC-8932
Miguel (Oncall): linking logs + severity? can you paste the exact errors and affected user ids?
Anna (Support): severity P1 for customer (prod impact). logs snippet:
```
2026-03-16T18:03:12Z ERROR scim-sync: deprovision failed user=acme/uid-842 request_id=req-0a1b2c KMS_ERROR=HSM_UNAVAILABLE
2026-03-16T18:03:13Z WARN auth: role_cleanup skipped user=acme/uid-842 reason=missing_audit_entry
```
They also attached a sample API request that supposedly should have generated audit events.
Rachel (CS): customer says 6 users were supposed to be removed yesterday, 3 still have access. asking for timeline and remediation asap.
Olivia (Security): thx. first questions: when did audit logs drop? retention window? any config changes around audit sink or retention policy in the last 48h?
Anna (Support): audit retention configured to 365 days for AcmeCorp. no manual changes reported by customer. internal deploy-bot shows a config push earlier today:
deploy-bot: "deploy complete: infra/audit-sink v2.14.3 by jay at 2026-03-16T17:50:01Z"
Jay (Eng-Infra): I pushed a patch to the audit sink — it included a kafka client bump. rolling back to v2.14.2 now to test. allocating ~5m.
Miguel (Oncall): while Jay rolls back, can someone check KMS health? which key? any HSM failover that hit customer?
Anna (Support): KMS key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/customer-acme. error rate spikes between 18:02–18:10 UTC.
Tom (Billing): quick note: there was an unexpected billing spike for AcmeCorp at 18:05 — ~3x normal token usage. could be retries from failed calls. flagging for billing review.
Olivia (Security): need to know whether missing audit entries are a retention truncation or never emitted. Check raw ingress (api-gateway) events for the same request_ids. if ingress has them but audit sink doesn't, it's sink issue.
Jay (Eng-Infra): confirmed ingress has the requests: `req-0a1b2c` and `req-0d4e5f` both successful at gateway level. sink consumer crashed during that window with `NullPointerException` in client codec; restarting consumer now.
Anna (Support): customer provided repro curl to trigger SCIM deprovision (they were using our SCIM endpoint):
```
curl -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/scim/Users/uid-842
```
They say after the call they got `204` but no audit entry.
Olivia (Security): if gateway returned 204 then audit emission should be synchronous before returning. maybe our path had a race where KMS error caused short-circuit after response. check service logs where we call `emit_audit(event)` — any exceptions?
Jay (Eng-Infra): looking — in codepath the audit emission is async with a best-effort retry. the consumer crash means events were acked locally but not delivered to long-term store. that's our gap.
Miguel (Oncall): action items: 1) stop-gap: re-run deprovision for affected users and create manual audit entries; 2) fix sink crash and reprocess missing events; 3) investigate KMS HSM errors root cause and failover behavior.
Anna (Support): I asked AcmeCorp for a list of the 6 user ids; they've shared: uid-842, uid-997, uid-101, uid-333, uid-404, uid-777. asking for confirmation before we re-run.
Rachel (CS): customer approved immediate remediation if we can guarantee no further data exposure. they want written confirmation of timeline and actions.
Olivia (Security): also need to confirm whether any RBAC role changes were applied incorrectly due to missing audit. if role removal didn't trigger, the users might have stale role bindings. request `role_binding` snapshots for the tenant at 2026-03-16T17:45 and 2026-03-16T18:15.
Jay (Eng-Infra): grabbing role snapshots from state-store now. attaching hashes: `snap-174a` (17:45) and `snap-178b` (18:15). diff shows role `editor` still bound to uid-842 in 18:15.
Anna (Support): so uid-842 kept `editor` — explains customer report.
Tom (Billing): billing spike likely due to retry loops from KMS failing to decrypt cached tokens — we should check client's retry logic and clear any stuck queues to stop extra charges.
Olivia (Security): question re: KMS: HSM_UNAVAILABLE implies hardware failover. did HSM pool failover happen? check Cloud KMS metrics and HSM alerts.
Jay (Eng-Infra): cloud provider reports transient HSM failover in region us-west1 at 18:01–18:06, with automatic retries. our KMS client got ECONNRESET then raised HSM_UNAVAILABLE. client retried causing duplicate attempts and some events were enqueued multiple times; consumer crash then caused drops.
Miguel (Oncall): proposed mitigation: 1) manual reconcile — run SCIM delete for listed uids and confirm role unbinds; 2) emit synthetic audit events into audit store for those deletes with `manually_reconciled=true`; 3) rotate any short-lived tokens if we suspect leakage; 4) billing credit review for AcmeCorp.
Olivia (Security): agree. for compliance, we must mark those synthetic audits with metadata and preserve original timestamps if possible. also create a security incident record for KMS availability impacting audit completeness.
Anna (Support): I'm drafting customer message with timeline + immediate actions. will include that we are re-running deprovision now and will follow up with confirmation once done.
Jay (Eng-Infra): reprocess job started to replay unacked events from local queue — ETA 12m. also rolled back audit-sink to v2.14.2 to prevent further drops.
Leon (Product): please capture root cause notes for the rollout that changed client lib — we need release gating for audit-critical paths. add to retro.
Tom (Billing): initiated billing review and opened ticket BILL-4521 for potential credit.
Rachel (CS): sending customer a targeted status update in 10m, cc: security + billing.
Miguel (Oncall): once reprocess completes, run smoke: check that for each uid we have an audit entry and role_binding shows removal. also validate KMS stability for 30m.
Anna (Support): update: reprocess finished. audit store shows synthetic entries for all 6 uids with `manually_reconciled=true`. role bindings reflect removals. KMS metrics show recovery after 18:10 and no further HSM errors.
Olivia (Security): filing internal incident: INCID-2026-03-KMS-AUDIT. attaching timeline and actions: rollback, reprocess, synthetic-audit, billing review. recommend follow-ups: improved SLAs on sink consumer, make audit emission synchronous for deprovision critical paths, and KMS client backoff tuning.
Rachel (CS): customer confirmed access removed and is asking for written incident report and confirmation of billing credit.
Tom (Billing): will update BILL-4521 after consulting finance.
Miguel (Oncall): closing loop: please add postmortem to `sources/slack/incidents` and assign owners. thanks all :thumbsup:
Anna (Support): will draft postmortem and ping @Leon for product action items. closing thread.
